What testing and the review found

FoundState
An open practice was a trap for the teacher: the quiz list showed no sign of it, pressing Start Lab Mode silently opened the practice page, and Edit said "running in Lab Mode".Fixed, with tests. See step 8.
After a practice ended, its tries and best scores could not be seen again.Fixed: "Practice scores" on the quiz's line.
A child doing practice could not be reached: a live quiz, a poll and Show to class did not come up over it.Fixed. See step 9.
Two teams with the same score were shown as first and second, and only one got the cup.Fixed in the code. Not looked at on a screen.
If a PC went off right after the last practice answer, the try stayed "not finished".Fixed, with a test: the last answer hands the try in.
The practice page showed "Nobody has started yet" above an empty list heading.Fixed
A team with one student shows that student's own score to the class as the team's average.Left as it is. Worth a decision.
A student who joins and never answers counts as 0 in the team's average.Left as it is (it follows from "average of the members").
With more teams than students, the empty teams are not listed.Left as it is
"Quizzes run" on the Teachers report counts a practice as a quiz run.Left as it is
On a 1280-wide window the quiz's line is crowded: Delete drops to a second line.Left as it is
